# shc_catalog (Data Source)

Fetches the SHC ordering catalog, listing available VPS packages and their resource specifications.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `packages` (Attributes List) The list of available VPS packages in the SHC catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) The number of CPU cores allocated to the package.
- `disk_gb` (Number) The amount of disk space in gigabytes.
- `memory_mb` (Number) The amount of memory in megabytes.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the package.
- `package_id` (Number) The SHC package ID.
